# HeadPain

> Map head pain on an interactive 3D head — intensity, depth, notes, local episode diary, JSON export, fully private

- Live: https://headpain.neorgon.com/
- Part of the Neorgon tool suite (free, no signup, runs in your browser): https://neorgon.com/
- Keywords: health, 3d, pain, diary, localstorage
